evidence_items.locator: Discussion preceding 'CritPt Benchmark Leaderboard - Results (18 Feb '26)'
evidence_items.explanation: The dated report places Gemini first overall and leading six component evaluations, supporting Google's competitive capability. It also places Gemini behind GPT-5.2 on GDPval-AA, showing that leadership varies by task; neither result establishes the moat explanation.

GLM-5's high placement supports the existence of a competitive Chinese alternative. The same report documents lower per-token prices than proprietary peers and limitations including text-only input; these comparisons do not identify why competitors converged.

Anthropic reports leadership on several evaluations and a GDPval-AA advantage over GPT-5.2. This supports the capability component, subject to vendor-reporting limitations, but not the asserted causal explanation.

unresolved_gaps: No evidence establishes that the absence of an OpenAI technical moat caused the observed convergence.
Benchmark proximity does not define the durability or defensibility of technical advantages.
Lower token prices do not guarantee lower cost for every task or equivalent service quality.
